name: Can you match my existing baseboards or door casings?

mainEntity.name: Can you match my existing baseboards or door casings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, matching existing trim is common, though older homes may feature discontinued profiles. We take a sample cut of your existing baseboard, casing, or crown molding to source an exact match from local lumber suppliers. If a standard stock profile is no longer manufactured, we can often combine multiple standard molding pieces to replicate the profile or custom-mill a replacement section. Providing clear photos or measuring the profile height and depth before an estimate helps determine availability quickly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, existing trim can usually be matched by sourcing identical stock profiles or combining standard moldings to replicate discontinued profiles.
